read.pageTitle: Transaction Propagation and Isolation in Spring @Transactional (Baeldung)

facts.summary: Spring ho tro 7 propagation: REQUIRED (mac dinh, dung tx hien co hoac tao moi), SUPPORTS (dung tx neu co, khong thi non-tx), MANDATORY (bat buoc phai co tx, nguoc lai nem exception), NEVER (khong duoc co tx), NOT_SUPPORTED (suspend tx hien co), REQUIRES_NEW (luon tao tx moi, suspend tx cu), NESTED (savepoint trong tx hien co, chi DataSourceTransactionManager ho tro).

Isolation co 5 muc: DEFAULT (dung mac dinh cua RDBMS), READ_UNCOMMITTED (doc duoc uncommitted data, tat ca side effects), READ_COMMITTED (ngan dirty read, mac dinh Postgres/SQL Server/Oracle), REPEATABLE_READ (ngan dirty + non-repeatable read, mac dinh MySQL), SERIALIZABLE (ngan het, chay serial, giam concurrency).
facts.locator: muc 4.1-4.5, bang tac dong side effects

facts.summary: Uu tien gan @Transactional tu thap den cao: interface < superclass < class < interface method < superclass method < class method; class-level ap dung cho tat ca public method chua co annotation.

facts.topic: Muc tieu chinh cua Spring Boot
facts.summary: Spring Boot co 3 muc tieu: (1) Getting-started experience nhanh hon cho Spring development; (2) Opinionated out-of-the-box nhung get out of the way khi can tu chinh; (3) Cung cap non-functional features chung: embedded servers, security, metrics, health checks, externalized config. Khong code generation (tru native image) va khong yeu cau XML config.
facts.locator: muc 'Overview', 'Spring Boot helps you to create stand-alone...', 3 primary goals

facts.topic: AuthenticationManager la API xac thuc trung tam
facts.summary: AuthenticationManager dinh nghia cach cac Filter cua Spring Security thuc hien xac thuc; Authentication tra ve se duoc set vao SecurityContextHolder boi chinh Filter da goi AuthenticationManager. Cai dat pho bien nhat la ProviderManager.

facts.topic: ProviderManager uy quyen cho danh sach AuthenticationProvider
facts.summary: ProviderManager uy quyen cho mot List AuthenticationProvider; moi AuthenticationProvider co the xac thuc thanh cong, that bai, hoac bo qua de AuthenticationProvider tiep theo quyet dinh. Neu khong provider nao xac thuc duoc, xac thuc that bai voi ProviderNotFoundException.

Khi user submit credentials, AbstractAuthenticationProcessingFilter tao mot Authentication tu HttpServletRequest (vi du UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter tao UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken), truyen vao AuthenticationManager; neu thanh cong thi set Authentication vao SecurityContextHolder va goi AuthenticationSuccessHandler, neu that bai thi xoa SecurityContextHolder va goi AuthenticationFailureHandler.

Interface Authentication vua la input cho AuthenticationManager mang theo credentials nguoi dung cung cap (isAuthenticated() tra false luc nay), vua dai dien cho user hien da xac thuc (lay qua SecurityContext); no chua principal (thuong la UserDetails), credentials (thuong la mat khau, bi xoa sau khi xac thuc) va authorities (GrantedAuthority nhu role/scope).

(1) Filter doc username/password tao UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken truyen vao AuthenticationManager (ProviderManager); (2) ProviderManager cau hinh dung DaoAuthenticationProvider; (3) DaoAuthenticationProvider tra UserDetails qua UserDetailsService; (4) dung PasswordEncoder de xac minh mat khau tren UserDetails vua lay; (5) neu thanh cong, tra ve UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken co principal la UserDetails, duoc Filter set vao SecurityContextHolder.

facts.topic: JwtEncoder la hop dong phat hanh JWT cua framework
facts.summary: JwtEncoder la functional interface trong org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt, co tu Spring Security 5.6; cai dat cua no chiu trach nhiem encode mot JWT thanh dang compact claims representation (JWS Compact Serialization neu ky, hoac JWE Compact Serialization neu ma hoa) - tuc viec ky/ma hoa duoc framework quan ly, khong tu viet tay.
JwtEncoder chi khai bao mot phuong thuc truu tuong: Jwt encode(JwtEncoderParameters parameters), nem JwtEncodingException neu loi; parameters chua JOSE header va JWT Claims Set can ma hoa.

facts.topic: NimbusJwtEncoder la cai dat JwtEncoder chinh thuc
facts.summary: NimbusJwtEncoder (tu Spring Security 5.6, dung thu vien Nimbus JOSE+JWT SDK) la cai dat JwtEncoder ky JWT theo JWS Compact Serialization; private/secret key dung de ky duoc cung cap qua mot JWKSource (com.nimbusds.jose.jwk.source.JWKSource) truyen vao constructor, khong phai tu cai thuat toan ky.

facts.topic: Ho tro ca khoa doi xung lan bat doi xung
facts.summary: Vi JWKSource cung cap khoa duoi dang JWK tong quat, NimbusJwtEncoder ho tro ca khoa bi mat doi xung (OctetSequenceKey, dung cho HMAC) lan cap khoa bat doi xung (RSAKey, ECKey) ma khong can doi API; o nhanh 6.5 chi co constructor nhan JWKSource duoc ghi nhan - cac builder tinh (withKeyPair/RsaKeyPairJwtEncoderBuilder/SecretKeyJwtEncoderBuilder) chi xuat hien tu nhanh 7.0 nen chua dung cho khoa hoc Spring Boot 3.x nay.

facts.topic: JwtClaimsSet dai dien tap claim cua JWT
facts.summary: JwtClaimsSet la lop final bieu dien JSON object chua cac claim cua JWT (implements JwtClaimAccessor), co tu Spring Security 5.6; JwtClaimsSet.Builder cung cap cac phuong thuc issuer(iss), subject(sub), audience(aud), issuedAt(iat), expiresAt(exp), notBefore(nbf), id(jti) cho cac registered claim chuan, cong them claim(name, value) cho claim tuy y.

JwtClaimsSet.builder() tao builder rong, JwtClaimsSet.from(claims) tao builder khoi tao san tu mot JwtClaimsSet co san de copy-and-modify (vi du doi lai expiresAt); build() tra ve JwtClaimsSet bat bien, getClaims() tra ve Map cac claim de dung khi lap JwtEncoderParameters.

facts.topic: JwsHeader la JOSE header mang thuat toan ky cua JWS
facts.summary: Javadoc mo ta JwsHeader ngan gon la 'JWS JOSE Header'; phuong thuc getAlgorithm() tra ve thuat toan JWA duoc dung de ky so JWS (hoac ma hoa JWE) va co kieu tra ve JwsAlgorithm. Nghia la thuat toan ky la mot phan metadata cua header, khong phai thuoc tinh cua claim set.

facts.topic: Chi tao JwsHeader qua with(JwsAlgorithm) roi build()
facts.summary: Trang Javadoc 6.5 cua JwsHeader khong co muc Constructor; chi co hai static factory tra ve JwsHeader.Builder la with(JwsAlgorithm jwsAlgorithm) va from(JwsHeader headers), cong voi nested static final class JwsHeader.Builder co build(). Vay de khai bao thuat toan ky can goi JwsHeader.with(<JwsAlgorithm>).build().

facts.topic: MacAlgorithm chi co dung ba hang so HMAC
facts.summary: Enum Constant Summary cua MacAlgorithm liet ke dung ba hang so: HS256 (HMAC using SHA-256, danh dau Required), HS384 (HMAC using SHA-384, Optional) va HS512 (HMAC using SHA-512, Optional). Vay HS256 la hang so bat buoc phai co, phu hop cho khoa bi mat doi xung cua du an.

facts.topic: MacAlgorithm nam o package jose.jws va la mot JwsAlgorithm
facts.summary: URL Javadoc cho thay MacAlgorithm thuoc org.springframework.security.oauth2.jose.jws - khac package org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt cua JwsHeader/JwtEncoderParameters, nen phai import rieng. Danh sach interface cua enum nay bao gom JwaAlgorithm va JwsAlgorithm, nen MacAlgorithm.HS256 dung duoc o cho can mot JwsAlgorithm.

facts.topic: Co hai overload from(), mot trong do nhan JwsHeader
facts.summary: Method Summary liet ke dung hai static factory: from(JwtClaimsSet claims) va from(JwsHeader jwsHeader, JwtClaimsSet claims) - ban hai tham so nhan JwsHeader truoc, claims sau, va Javadoc noi no khoi tao JwtEncoderParameters voi ca JwsHeader lan JwtClaimsSet duoc cung cap. Day la ban duy nhat cho phep khai bao thuat toan ky khi goi encode().

facts.topic: getJwsHeader() la @Nullable nen ban mot tham so bo trong header
facts.summary: getJwsHeader() duoc chu thich @Nullable va Javadoc ghi tra ve JwsHeader hoac null neu khong duoc chi dinh. Vay JwtEncoderParameters.from(claims) tao tham so voi JWS header bang null, tuc khong he khai bao thuat toan ky nao cho encoder.

facts.topic: Secret HMAC phai dai toi thieu 256 bit
facts.summary: Ca bon constructor cua MACSigner (byte[], String, SecretKey, OctetSequenceKey) deu ghi cung mot dieu kien cho tham so secret: phai dai it nhat 256 bit va khong duoc null; neu ngan hon nguong 256-bit toi thieu do thi constructor nem KeyLengthException. Vay 256 bit (32 byte UTF-8) la nguong san toi thieu duoc tai lieu hoa cho chinh viec dung MACSigner, khong phai mot con so suy dien.

facts.topic: Nguong toi thieu la thuoc tinh cua tung thuat toan HMAC
facts.summary: Javadoc con phoi ra static int getMinRequiredSecretLength(JWSAlgorithm alg) tra ve do dai secret toi thieu tinh bang bit cho thuat toan HMAC duoc chi dinh, cong voi getCompatibleAlgorithms(int secretLength) tra ve tap thuat toan tuong thich va tra ve tap rong khi secret qua ngan cho bat ky thuat toan nao. Nghia la nguong toi thieu duoc tra theo tung thuat toan chu khong phai mot con so chung, nen khi doi thuat toan thi phai tra lai bang chinh phuong thuc nay; trang Javadoc nay khong in ra con so cu the cho HS384/HS512.
